in_marathi.name: Bhoomija
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhoomija हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhoomija is the Sanskrit word for 'earth' or 'goddess of the earth'. In Hindu mythology, she is the wife of Lord Vishnu and the mother of all living beings. She is also known as Prithvi Devi and is revered for her nurturing and protective qualities.
